subject: Rivermount CAIQ + access/log samples request — scheduling call
messages:
From: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@rivermount.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: security@rivermount.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Rivermount CAIQ & log samples request

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Rivermount's compliance team is kicking off the technical review for our procurement window and we need two things to proceed: a completed CAIQ (we prefer the CSV/Excel format) and a small sample of access logs and audit trails that demonstrate identity events and key management activity for the past 30 days.

Specifically we need:
- CAIQ spreadsheet (completed)
- SOC 2 snapshot / attestation (PDF)
- Log samples: auth events, role changes, KMS usage traces (anonymized is fine)

Can we do a 30-minute call next week to walk through the artifacts and a secure upload mechanism? Our team is available Tue/Wed 10–1 PT or Thu 2–4 PT. If you prefer a different window let me know.

Also: do you have an internal owner we should coordinate with for rotated keys/access logs?

Thanks,
Jordan Miller
Security Engineer | Rivermount
jordan.miller@rivermount.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@rivermount.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermount CAIQ & log samples request

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the CAIQ and a SOC 2 snapshot, and we can produce anonymized log exports for the categories you listed.

Proposed slots (30 min):
- Tue 2026-06-22 10:30 PT
- Wed 2026-06-23 11:00 PT
- Thu 2026-06-24 14:30 PT

Please pick one and I'll send a calendar invite. For uploads: we use a customer artifact folder (encrypted at rest) and can provide an S3 pre-signed URL or a secure Google Drive folder depending on your preference. If you need an encrypted transfer, we can provision a temporary SFTP link.

I attached a blank CAIQ template and our most recent SOC 2 snapshot for your team to review. I'll loop in Marissa to coordinate the log extraction and Olga for the CAIQ crosswalk.

Attachments: redwood_caiq_2026.xlsx; redwood_soc2_snapshot_2026-06.pdf

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@rivermount.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermount CAIQ & log samples request — owners and plan

Thanks — putting owners on this thread.

Action plan (short):
1) CAIQ / attestation: Olga will complete the CAIQ crosswalk and mark evidence references in the sheet (owner: olga_petrov).
2) Log samples: I'll run the export for auth events and key usage and scrub PII/anonymize identifiers (owner: marissa_cole). Expected export size: ~5–10MB compressed.
3) Upload: we can provide either a pre-signed S3 link (preferred) or a secure Drive folder. If Rivermount wants SFTP we can stand one up but it will take ~24 hours.

Estimated timeline: CAIQ + SOC2 snapshot — same day. Log export & scrub — within 48 hours after call.

Jordan — can you confirm which upload mechanism you prefer and which slot from Jasmine's list works? Once confirmed I'll start the export runbook.

Attachment: log_export_instructions.md (internal runbook excerpt)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Technical Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@rivermount.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermount CAIQ & log samples request — scheduling call confirmed

Hi Jasmine / Marissa / Olga —

Thanks, Tue 2026-06-22 10:30 PT works for us (please send an invite). We prefer the S3 pre-signed link for the upload. For the log export, anonymization is fine as long as timestamp fidelity and event sequence are preserved. If you can include a short readme describing what was redacted, that will help our intake team.

I'll send a calendar invite for the Rivermount side and will include our procurement contact in the invite. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Jordan
